posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: Foote is also totally right about tooling - this is the most "bits" intensive game we have made so far, and it is likely to take a while to get it right. On top of that, some things are very preliminary (like the sculpts for invader pieces, which are being worked on as we speak based on all of your feedback!), so we have to finalize them, THEN do tooling, which will take even more time.
